title: Compatible finite coefficient-unit coordinates in normalized geometry
statement: For every prime l, finite extension E of Q_l, schemes X,Y and f:X→Y, choose Base b and Geometry g [def-sp-tower-shriek-data] with levelPushUnderlying acting identically on every underlying section. There are finite module isomorphisms delta_n from the n-th evaluation of g.pull of the coefficient system [def-sp-tower-class-systems, def-sp-tower-class-coefficients] to the n-th coefficient module on X. Their hom maps commute with each quotient transition. Transposing ordinaryPullEvaluation.inv followed by delta_n.hom along the actual finite constant-ring adjunction gives the canonical unital constant direct-image map on every coefficient section (with HEq for the coefficient and unit-module carriers). This asserts only finite maps and their horizontal compatibility, not an assembled coefficient-system isomorphism, and asserts no tensor comparison.

source.place: clause (2), finite unit and tensor maps and their transposes

proof.text: Choose Base and Geometry with identity direct-image underlying section comparisons, before selecting any unit maps.

At each finite level use exists_finiteUnitIso, proved by the regular-module global-section universal property and finality of pro-etale base change. Compose with ordinaryPullEvaluation. The inverse comparison cancels in the transpose, proving the exact section normalization.

Apply unit_successor_compatibility to these normalized maps. At each site object apply Mathlib NatTrans.ofOpSequence to the underlying section functors on the opposite natural numbers. The adjacent module equations give its hypotheses by the actual transition section formula. Naturality of the resulting transformation at n<=m gives all transition squares, including equality indices. Sectionwise extensionality gives the required module square.

theorem exists_unitLevelCoordinates {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    ∃ b : SpTowerShriek.Base l E, ∃ g : SpTowerShriek.Geometry l E b f,
      (∀ (n : ℕ)
        (N : SemilinearSections.Mod.{u + 1, u, u + 1} (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
          (g.generic.coefficients n)) (U : Y.ProEtᵒᵖ)
        (x : ((SemilinearSections.underlying.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
          (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) (SpTowerShriek.B l E Y n)).obj
            ((g.generic.levelPush n).obj N)).obj.obj U),
        HEq (((g.generic.levelPushUnderlying n).hom.app N).hom.app U x) x) ∧ ∃ δ : ∀ n : ℕ,
      (SpTowerShriek.ev l E X n).obj
          (g.pull.obj (coefficient Y (Arings l E Y))) ≅
        (SpTowerShriek.ev l E X n).obj (coefficient X (Arings l E X)),
      (∀ {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m),
        (SemilinearSections.transition (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
            (SpTowerShriek.B l E X) (SpTowerShriek.tau l E X) h).app
            (g.pull.obj (coefficient Y (Arings l E Y))) ≫
          (SemilinearSections.res (SemilinearSections.coefficientMap
            (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (SpTowerShriek.B l E X)
            (SpTowerShriek.tau l E X) h)).map (δ n).hom =
        (δ m).hom ≫ (SemilinearSections.transition (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
          (SpTowerShriek.B l E X) (SpTowerShriek.tau l E X) h).app
            (coefficient X (Arings l E X))) ∧
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Y.ProEtᵒᵖ)
        (x : (SpTowerShriek.B l E Y n).obj.obj U)
        (x' : ((SpTowerShriek.ev l E Y n).obj
          (coefficient Y (Arings l E Y))).val.obj U),
        HEq x x' → HEq
          ((((Scheme.proEtaleConstantRingAdjunction (SpTowerShriek.R l E n) f).homEquiv
            _ _) ((g.ordinaryPullEvaluation n).inv.app
              (coefficient Y (Arings l E Y)) ≫ (δ n).hom)).val.app U x')
          ((Scheme.proEtaleConstantDirectImageMap.{u, u + 2} f CommRingCat.{u + 1}
            (CommRingCat.of.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (SpTowerShriek.R l E n)))).hom.app
              U x)
